verseGurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਾਹੁ ॥
verseTranslation: My Beloved Lord Himself pervades and permeates all; He Himself is, all by Himself.

verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translation: My Beloved Lord Himself pervades and permeates all; He Himself is, all by Himself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translation: My Beloved Himself is the trader in this world; He Himself is the true banker.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translation: My Beloved Himself is the trade and the trader; He Himself is the true credit. ||1||

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹ ॥
verses.translation: O mind, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, and praise His Name.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Beloved, Ambrosial, unapproachable and unfathomable Lord is obtained. ||Pause||

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਭ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਹਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself sees and hears everything; He Himself speaks through the mouths of all beings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself leads us into the wilderness, and He Himself shows us the Way.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is Himself all-in-all; He Himself is carefree. ||2||

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਧੰਧੜੈ ਲਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself, all by Himself, created everything; He Himself links all to their tasks.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself creates the Creation, and He Himself destroys it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਤਣੁ ਪਾਤਣੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translation: He Himself is the wharf, and He Himself is the ferryman, who ferries us across. ||3||

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is the ocean, and the boat; He Himself is the Guru, the boatman who steers it

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵੇਖੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translation: . The Beloved Himself sets sail and crosses over; He, the King, beholds His wondrous play.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਹੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is the Merciful Master; O servant Nanak, He forgives and blends with Himself. ||4||1||
